title: Coherent higher direct images over a valuation ring
statement: Let A be a valuation ring, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let F be a \mathcal O_X-module that is locally free of constant finite rank [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Then for every q\geq0, H^q(X,F) is a finitely presented A-module.
